data.description: ## Testing Mode UPDATE ## Story DD Coverage DD3: adding Gemini requires only new file + config key, no changes to runner.py ## Problem runner.py line ~60 hardcodes:   from dso_ci_review.providers.anthropic import review_diff This means adding a new provider (Gemini) would require changing runner.py, violating DD3. ## Fix Update runner.py main() to use get_provider() from providers/config.py: ```python from dso_ci_review.providers.config import get_provider, ConfigError, AuthError def main() -> int:     dry_run = os.environ.get("DSO_CI_REVIEW_DRY_RUN") == "1"     if dry_run:         _write_output({"findings": [], "dry_run": True})         return 0     diff_text = _read_diff()     if not diff_text.strip():         _write_output({"findings": []})         return 0     try:         provider = get_provider()     except ConfigError as exc:         print(f"ERROR: provider config: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)         return 1     except AuthError as exc:         print(f"ERROR: provider auth: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)         return 1     model = os.environ.get("DSO_CI_REVIEW_MODEL")     kwargs: dict = {}     if model:         kwargs["model"] = model     try:         result = provider.review_diff(diff_text, **kwargs)     except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001         print(f"ERROR: LLM call failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)         return 1     _write_output(result)     return 0 ``` ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes   Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh - [ ] ruff check passes   Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py - [ ] runner.py no longer imports from providers.anthropic directly   Verify: ! grep "from dso_ci_review.providers.anthropic import" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py - [ ] runner.py uses get_provider()   Verify: grep "get_provider" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py - [ ] DSO_CI_REVIEW_DRY_RUN=1 still works (smoke test)   Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts DSO_CI_REVIEW_DRY_RUN=1 DSO_CI_REVIEW_DIFF_PATH=tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/fixture-diff.txt python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert 'findings' in d" ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
data.title: Fix runner.py to route through get_provider() for provider-agnostic dispatch (DD3)
